---
name: curation-entry
description: Add a skill milestone or learning step to Ventura Roadmap with prerequisites outcome and sequence justified. Use when extending an independent career or learning roadmap. Do not use when prescribing a personalized career plan from private user history.
---

# Curation entry

- Read the existing roadmap sequence before adding a step.
- Define the prerequisite and observable outcome of the new step.
- Place it where dependency order justifies it rather than by popularity.
- Link canonical learning references when needed.
- Avoid duplicate milestones that teach the same outcome.
- Keep vendor-specific tools optional unless the roadmap explicitly targets them.
